capability_profile.schema: one fixed table named t1 with one INTEGER column named x
statements: SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x < <signed-i32>
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x = <signed-i32>
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x > <signed-i32>
capability_profile.result_contract: execute returns a row/change count or a negative error; SELECT rows are materialized separately from table and embedded-constant storage, then read with result_count and result_get

errors.-4: row or result index out of bounds
errors.-10: unsupported/malformed SQL or invalid input memory range

unsupported: WHERE expressions other than signed <, =, or > comparison between x and one signed-i32 literal
predicate-qualified UPDATE and computed update expressions

properties: state agrees with an independent ordered-list model
DELETE count equals the number of matching rows
deleting an absent value is an identity operation
equality-filter results agree with an independent model
signed less-than and greater-than results agree with an independent model and preserve row order
for every pivot, the <, =, and > partitions are disjoint and recombine to the full table multiset
all-row UPDATE change counts and resulting values agree with an independent model
syntax and integer-range rejection are atomic
out-of-bounds input ranges return -10 without trapping or mutation
failed SELECT clears stale query results

compared_behavior: ordered SELECT x FROM t1 results
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x <, =, or > <signed-i32> results
DELETE change counts and resulting state
all-row UPDATE change counts and resulting state
